texts.zh:
我们失去了[From.GetName]星系内的祝圣之物！

悲痛与沉重的失落笼罩了[Root.GetAdj]的殖民地。不同于一个星球被宣布不再为神所庇佑，这种对心灵依靠的以暴力手段无情践踏否定的行为让[Root.GetName]的信徒们陷入震惊与迷茫。神职人员决定进行五年的哀悼。
texts.en:
We have lost access to the objects of worship in the [From.GetName] system!

Grief and a profound sense of loss grips the [Root.GetAdj] colonies. Different from a world being declared unconsecrated, this violent denial of spiritual agency leaves the believers of [Root.GetName] shell-shocked and disoriented. The clergy have decreed a half-decade of mourning.
